recommended_storage_facility: Evaporative cool chamber / Specialized cold storage
primary_risk_factors: Rapid fungal rot (Botrytis / Alternaria); moisture desiccation; chilling injury below 10 deg C; skin bruising during transit
tier1_icar_ciphet_citation: ICAR-CIPHET (2015): Total supply-chain loss for tomato = 44.6% of harvested weight nationally. Storage loss at farm level = 8-12% per week under ambient UP temperatures (35-42 deg C). Sinha et al. (2015), Post-Harvest Losses of Tomato in India, CIPHET Ludhiana, pp. 34-41.
tier2_cwc_nca_regulatory_citation: NCA Report: Cold chain infrastructure for vegetables mandatory beyond 48 h. CWC does not operate vegetable cold chains; NCCD poly-house and pre-cooling norms apply.
tier3_up_mandi_parishad_operational_cita: UP Mandi Parishad Bye-Law Chapter 4, Schedule B: Tomato - Highly Perishable Grade-1. Palledari Rs 15-20/qtl. Mandi Fee 2.0%. Spoilage disputes adjudicated within 48 h.
tier4_farmgate_local_supply_chain_quote: Baripaal mandi Kanpur (2025): Hum kal ka tomato aaj nahi rakh sakte. Jo aaya woh bika - nahin to kachre mein gaya. Rate sham ko alag hai subah ko alag. Teen din mein half ho jaata hai. — Licensed Commission Agent, Baripaal APMC, Kanpur.
operational_recommendation: SELL SAME DAY AT ARRIVAL. Do NOT store under any condition. Model must output SELL for all tomato observations at T+7.

primary_risk_factors: Pitting; yellowing; water-soaked tissue breakdown; chilling sensitivity below 7 deg C
tier1_icar_ciphet_citation: ICAR-CIPHET (2015): Cucumber post-harvest ambient loss = 30-45% within 3 days at >35 deg C. National Survey of Post-Harvest Losses, CIPHET Ludhiana, Table 7.
tier2_cwc_nca_regulatory_citation: No CWC or SWC cold storage designated for cucumbers in UP. NCCD Reefer van guidelines: maintain 10-12 deg C during transit; max window 18 h.
tier3_up_mandi_parishad_operational_cita: UP Mandi Parishad: Perishable Grade-1. Palledari Rs 15-18/qtl. Mandi Fee 2.0%. Market committee can mandate distress sale if holding creates public health risk.
tier4_farmgate_local_supply_chain_quote: Unnao Mandi (June 2026): Kheera ek raat se zyada toh chalta hi nahi UP ke garmi mein. Kharidar bhi nahi leta agar thoda bhi peela ho gaya. — Vegetable Trader, Unnao.
operational_recommendation: SELL SAME DAY. No storage viable. Model outputs mandatory SELL for all cucumber observations.

primary_risk_factors: Calyx browning; surface scald; decay; extreme moisture transpiration
tier1_icar_ciphet_citation: ICAR-CIPHET (2015): Brinjal post-harvest ambient loss = 25-38% per week. National Survey of Post-Harvest Losses, Table 9.
tier2_cwc_nca_regulatory_citation: No WDRA-accredited storage for brinjal in UP. No CWC cold chain for vegetable categories below Rs 50 crore annual throughput threshold.
tier3_up_mandi_parishad_operational_cita: UP Mandi Parishad Bye-Law: Brinjal - Perishable Grade-1. Mandi Fee 2.0%. Palledari Rs 14-18/qtl.
tier4_farmgate_local_supply_chain_quote: Kanpur Dehat (Kharif 2025): Baigan mein risk hai. Teen din baad color change ho jaata. Koi nahi khareedta. — Farmer, Kanpur Dehat.
operational_recommendation: SELL WITHIN 2-3 DAYS. No economic basis for any storage decision at T+7.

optimal_storage_temp_celsius: 0 to 2 deg C (Cold) or 25 to 30 deg C (Ambient dry)
recommended_storage_facility: Traditional ventilated wooden chawl / Modern cold storage
primary_risk_factors: Sprouting if RH > 75%; black mould (Aspergillus); neck rot; weight shrinkage from transpiration
tier1_icar_ciphet_citation: ICAR-CIPHET (2022): Onion annual post-harvest loss = 25-30% nationally. Farm-level ambient chawl storage: 1.5-2.5% per week physical shrinkage. CIPHET Post-Harvest Survey 2022, Chapter 5, Table 5.2.
tier2_cwc_nca_regulatory_citation: CWC Tariff FY2025-26: General Commodity Storage for Onion Rs 22.35/qtl/month. WDRA: 47 registered warehouses for onion in UP across Kanpur, Lucknow, Unnao. NCA: Onion designated Essential Commodity; ECA 1955 price control applicable.
tier3_up_mandi_parishad_operational_cita: UP Mandi Parishad Bye-Law Schedule C: Onion (Rabi) - Semi-Perishable Grade-2. Mandi Fee 2.0%. Palledari Rs 10-14/qtl. NABARD Produce Pledge Loan scheme active for onion stored in registered godowns adjacent to mandis.
tier4_farmgate_local_supply_chain_quote: Unnao Mandi (March 2026): Rabi pyaz mein 2-3 mahine tak theek rehta hai agar dhang se rakho. Chawl mein rakho hawar aane do. 4 mahine mein rate double ho jaata sometimes. — Large Onion Trader, Unnao.
operational_recommendation: HOLD 60-120 days in ventilated chawl if harvest price < Rs 1000/qtl. T+7 break-even (+6%) occurs only 9% of the time. Multi-month holding economically viable.

optimal_storage_temp_celsius: 2 to 4 deg C (Table) or 8 to 10 deg C (Processing)
recommended_storage_facility: Industrial cold storage godown (UP has >2000 units)
primary_risk_factors: Sprouting above 10 deg C; greening under light (toxic solanine); tuber rot (soft rot / dry rot); cold sweetening
tier1_icar_ciphet_citation: ICAR-CIPHET (2015, 2022): Potato cold-storage loss = 2-4% over 6-month season. Ambient village pit storage loss = 15-25% over 30 days. CIPHET Post-Harvest Survey 2022, Chapter 4, Table 4.1.
tier2_cwc_nca_regulatory_citation: CWC UP Region: Potato cold storage tariff Rs 20.00-30.00/qtl/month. UP has 2300+ registered cold stores (75% in Agra-Kanpur belt). Average capacity utilization Rabi 2025: 78%. WDRA: 186 UP cold stores registered for e-NWR pledge loans on potato.
tier3_up_mandi_parishad_operational_cita: UP Mandi Parishad Schedule C: Potato - Semi-Perishable Grade-2. Mandi Fee 2.0%. Palledari Rs 10-12/qtl. KCC pledge loans on cold-stored potato at 7% p.a. widely utilized by UP traders.
tier4_farmgate_local_supply_chain_quote: Kanpur (2026): Aalu mein cold storage ka khel hai. Rate June-July mein uthta hai. Jo February-March mein daala aur July tak rakha uska maal chal jaata hai. Lekin cold storage ka kiraya aur interest milake +5 rupye per kg toh chahiye minimum. — Cold Storage Operator, Kanpur.
operational_recommendation: STORE IN COLD STORAGE 60-150 days if harvest price < Rs 700/qtl. T+7 decision economically unviable. Model outputs SELL at T+7; HOLD flag for multi-month seasonal arbitrage.

recommended_storage_facility: CWC / SWC Warehouse; CAP godown; Silos
primary_risk_factors: Stored grain insect pests (Sitophilus oryzae weevil; Rhyzopertha dominica borer); rodent attacks; moisture condensation; bird spillage
economic_viability_verdict_t7: UNVIABLE AT T+7 (Fixed friction exceeds gain)
economic_viability_verdict_multi_month: HIGHLY VIABLE FOR 3-6 MONTH HARVEST-TO-LEAN CYCLE
tier1_icar_ciphet_citation: ICAR-CIPHET (2022): Wheat storage loss in CAP godowns = 0.3-0.5%/month under proper Aluminum Phosphide fumigation. Farm-level kuchcha storage loss = 1.5-3.5%/season. CIPHET Storage Loss Assessment 2022, Table 3.1.
tier2_cwc_nca_regulatory_citation: CWC Tariff Circular FY2025-26 (Ref CWC/SD/2025/Circ-07): Wheat storage tariff Rs 17.29/qtl/month (Type-1 bagged) to Rs 23.10/qtl/month (Type-2 CAP). MSP Wheat RMS 2025-26: Rs 2425/qtl Cabinet approved. FCI procurement active in Kanpur, Lucknow, Unnao.
tier3_up_mandi_parishad_operational_cita: UP Mandi Parishad Schedule A: Wheat - Durable Grain. Mandi Fee 1.5% (reduced for FCI procurement). Development Cess 0.5%. Weighment fee Rs 2/qtl. Palledari Rs 8-10/qtl. Total friction at MSP sale: Rs 35-45/qtl.
tier4_farmgate_local_supply_chain_quote: Baripaal APMC Kanpur (April 2026): Gehu ka chakkar alag hai. FCI rate pe becha toh seedha paisa. Market mein rakha 3 mahine toh 200-300 upar milta hai. 7 din mein kuch nahi hoga - aana-jaana ka kharch bhi nahi uthega. — Wheat Trader, Baripaal APMC.
operational_recommendation: SELL TO FCI AT MSP (Rs 2425/qtl) OR HOLD MINIMUM 60 DAYS for private market premium. T+7 storage consistently loses money. Model must output SELL or HOLD>60days; never HOLD-7.

recommended_storage_facility: Standard bag godowns / CWC railhead warehouses
primary_risk_factors: Milling yield reduction if improperly dried; grain moth (Sitotroga); yellowing under heat
tier1_icar_ciphet_citation: ICAR-CIPHET (2022): Rice / Paddy post-harvest loss = 5-9% nationally across field to retail chain. Storage-specific loss in proper godowns = 0.3-0.6%/month. CIPHET 2022, Chapter 3.
tier2_cwc_nca_regulatory_citation: CWC Tariff FY2025-26: Paddy storage Rs 17.29/qtl/month. MSP Common Paddy KMS 2025-26: Rs 2300/qtl. FCI/State agencies procure actively in UP eastern districts. WDRA: Paddy e-NWR pledge loans available at 7% KCC rate.
tier3_up_mandi_parishad_operational_cita: UP Mandi Parishad Schedule A: Paddy/Rice - Durable Grain. Mandi Fee 1.5%. Palledari Rs 8-10/qtl. 72 UP mandis notified as procurement centers for KMS 2025-26.
tier4_farmgate_local_supply_chain_quote: Baripaal APMC Kanpur (November 2025): Dhan ka rate October-November mein neeche rehta. Jo 2-3 mahine rakha uska margin nikla. 7 din mein holding ka koi faida nahi - bori ka kharch bhi nahi niklega. — Paddy Trader, Baripaal APMC.
operational_recommendation: SELL AT PROCUREMENT PRICE OR HOLD 90+ DAYS for lean-season premium. 7-day holding loses money 87% of the time.

primary_risk_factors: Oxidative rancidity if stored damp/hot; weevil infestation; seed caking
tier1_icar_ciphet_citation: ICAR-CIPHET (2015): Mustard/rapeseed ambient storage loss under proper dry conditions = 0.3-0.5%/month. Rancidity risk sharply increases above 12% seed moisture content. CIPHET Storage Survey 2015, Table 4.7.
tier2_cwc_nca_regulatory_citation: CWC Tariff FY2025-26: Oilseed storage Rs 18.00-24.00/qtl/month. MSP Mustard RMS 2025-26: Rs 5950/qtl Cabinet approved. Rajasthan-UP supply corridor active for mustard trade.
tier3_up_mandi_parishad_operational_cita: UP Mandi Parishad Schedule A: Mustard - Durable Oilseed. Mandi Fee 2.0%. Palledari Rs 8-10/qtl.
tier4_farmgate_local_supply_chain_quote: Jhansi (February 2026): Sarson ka maal 4-5 mahine mein upar jaata. Rabi mein rate neeche hota garmiyun mein tel mehanga hone par sarson bhi uthti. 7 din mein toh kuch nahi milega - bas dhulai ka kharch. — Oilseed Trader, Jhansi.
operational_recommendation: HOLD 90-180 DAYS for oil-price-driven seasonal premium. Sell to MSP procurement (Rs 5950/qtl) as floor. T+7 storage uneconomical.

primary_risk_factors: Pulse beetle (Callosobruchus maculatus); bruchid emergence; moisture absorption; hard seed coat development
tier1_icar_ciphet_citation: ICAR-CIPHET (2022): Pulse storage loss without fumigation = 15-20% over 6 months (Callosobruchus bruchid beetles). With Aluminum Phosphide fumigation: < 0.5%/month. CIPHET 2022, Chapter 6.
tier2_cwc_nca_regulatory_citation: CWC Tariff FY2025-26: Pulses storage Rs 18.00-25.00/qtl/month. MSP Gram RMS 2025-26: Rs 5650/qtl. NAFED active procurement in UP mandi procurement camps.
tier3_up_mandi_parishad_operational_cita: UP Mandi Parishad Schedule A: Gram/Chana - Durable Pulse. Mandi Fee 2.0%. Palledari Rs 8-10/qtl.
tier4_farmgate_local_supply_chain_quote: Jhansi Mandi (March 2026): Chana mein 3-4 mahine ka khelra hai. Rabi mein bechenge toh 5500-5600 June-July mein 6200-6500. Lekin ghun lag gaya toh sab barbaad. Fumigation jaruri hai - Rs 3-4 per bag. — Pulse Trader, Jhansi.
operational_recommendation: HOLD 90-180 DAYS with mandatory fumigation for seasonal premium. MSP floor provides downside protection. T+7 uneconomical.
